note: Subject-expert QA findings on assets reused or considered for Physics School V1. Read by curriculum/school/readiness.js. Status: open | fixed | wontfix. 'inUse' says where the asset reaches pupils today, independent of the school programme. Full detail in the linked reports.

findings.summary: Q5 model answer uses 'electrical energy / light and thermal energy pathways' (stores vs pathways confusion, MIS-PHY-ENE-002).
Grade 9 challenge concludes 'same speed' from average speeds only.
Q14 stem 'two identical balls of different mass' is self-contradictory; release time not stated.
Q8: F = ma stem does not say the force is the resultant force.
Zero resultant force explanations omit zero acceleration / constant velocity (exit ticket Q3 and key distinction).
Prefix table lacks T, G, M (required by the approved concept card; essential for MJ/MW/GW).
Three different calculation routines across the Week 1 lesson and closing lesson.
Recall equations printed in the baseline diagnostic, so recall failures are undetectable.
Reveal-answer buttons are available during the diagnostic and exit ticket; neither is independent evidence.
Mini challenge asks no question; Q7 relies on untaught a = Δv/t and F = ma.
Student reflection saved to a field named 'teacherDecision'; 'discussionNotes' is both a pupil and a teacher field.
Kettle Sankey: useful output includes the kettle and air; sound is the only waste.
Sankey widths do not conserve and contradict the printed rule.
Braking Sankey: 10-20% to 'Sound energy'; forms-of-energy labels; heating drawn at the bumper.
Pathways diagram: 'Particles' as a pathway; radiation listed twice; 'Light' as a pathway.
'Transfer Chain System' image is a byte-identical copy of the pathways image: there is no chain.
'GPE is converted to KE', 'ENERGY TRANSFORMATION' (conversion language).
Master overview image: 'Electrical/Light/Sound energy'; mock UI screenshot.
Specification mapping claims calculations the lesson does not contain; wrong tier statement.
6-mark task repeats a worked answer shown minutes earlier; levels have no mark bands.
Edexcel mapping unverified ('Topic 1 Energy' is wrong for Edexcel).
